_a17_design_notes.panel_long_only_vs_survivors_only_lag1_b: panel_long_only (A-17) = §5b ① panel-wide equal-weight hold, no ranking, no shorts, no alpha. survivors_only_lag1_book (M-115) = §5b ④ book with cross-sectional ranking. _a17_design_notes.min_history_days_60_rationale: Spec default (load() rejection threshold) is 30; production pin to 60 to give 1-2 weeks of buffer above the production limit. coingecko_pro_ohlc has 73d as of 2026-09-17 — passes 60d by 13d. If data shrinks, expect BLOCKED until it grows back. ARCHITECTURE §5b ① is regime-blind by design (the FoF core benchmark should hold through everything)
_a17_design_notes.regime_gate_empty_rationale: Empty dict = no regime-driven SKIPPED. This is correct for §5b ① benchmark — 'hold the panel' means hold through all regimes. If you want to gate, add {'RISK_OFF': false} explicitly.
_a17_design_notes.cap_0.30_with_5_symbols: 1/N = 0.20 < 0.30 → cap does NOT trigger. This is the 'no cash drag' shape. Real production wants full deployment at benchmark weight (no half-cash from a cap the user didn't intend).
_a17_design_notes.weekly_rebalance_rationale: 7d cadence matches M-115 R14-Lite cadence. Same operational heartbeat, different shape — keeps ops simple during paper tracking.
_a17_design_notes.v1_ship_only_equal_weight: Spec.load (spec_runner.py:375-379) REJECTS allocation != equal_weight in v1 ship. cis_weight + market_cap_weight are next-tier (next ship) per PANEL_LONG_ONLY_SPEC §'Allocation helpers'.
